evidence: Parsed with Python 3.11+ tomllib on the frozen snapshot: task.toml (keys schema_version, artifacts, task, metadata, agent, environment, verifier), tests/scoring.toml (gates/weights/floors) and all five judge.toml files (gates/render 1 criterion, gates/constraints 1, scored/functional 16, scored/polish 6, scored/visual 4) load without error. bash -n passes for tests/test.sh and solution/solve.sh, both start with #!/bin/bash, are mode 755, and `grep -rlI $''` over the whole task finds no CR byte anywhere (all LF). environment/assets/seed_data.json, solution/app/seed/seed_data.json (byte-identical, sha256 b256f85e...7bf8) and solution/app/package.json parse as JSON; `node --check` (v24.19.0) passes for solution/app/server.js and public/app.js; tests/tools/score.py and restart_mcp.py py_compile cleanly; test.sh, restart_mcp.py and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template. Would-run: server.js requires only express and better-sqlite3, both globally installed at pinned versions by environment/Dockerfile with NODE_PATH set; it listens on PORT||3000 and serves /api/health (server.js:13,42), matching test.sh:48,97-111. Frozen-file hashes for server.js, app.js, package.json, solve.sh and seed match raw-evidence-index matching_source_files, and golden-run.log (hash verified) shows the app installed by the frozen solve.sh booting 'on port 3000' twice across a real restart with all 23 scripted checks PASS. Broken-app probe: a submission with a CRLF/syntax-broken server.js is outside this row (gates/render handle it); a conforming alternative cannot fail this row because it only concerns task-owned files. Residual risk: functional judge.toml uses mode = "individual" (deviation from template batched/9000, comment says lead-instructed, 'Not yet measured against a judge run'); it parses, but no full configured RewardKit run on these bytes shows RewardKit accepts and executes it, and the raw-evidence index states such a run is absent. Parse-level checks are not execution of the private deterministic checker suite.
